path.behavior: After child creation succeeds, emits a Started SubAgentActivity with child thread ID and task path.
SubAgentActivity is emitted through ItemStarted and ItemCompleted.
Canonical ItemStarted and ItemCompleted are forwarded to app-server clients.
The mapper supports selected ThreadItem variants including CollabAgentToolCall; unsupported variants fall through to None, so SubAgentActivity is not serialized as an exec JSON item.
